plugins.name: ace
plugins.description: v7.1.3: Subagent session-anchoring correctness + SubagentStop observability. No floor bump. R2: unconditional task_session_id seed — ace_before_task and ace_subagent_start now persist the per-task uuid4 BEFORE the search and any early-exits so subagents that hit early-exits still carry session_id on their traces (server anchors to stamped search rows, recovering eval-gold). R1: SubagentStop invariant monitor emits subagent_stop_keymap to ace-relevance.jsonl (read_key, transcript_uuid, invariant_ok); dead recovery branch removed (inert, 5/5 probes). v7.1.2: Injection quality + correctness hardening. Quality gate keep iff NOT isAtRisk AND cumulative_v15_reward >= 0. Domain-shift bounded server-side via --top-k 8. Floor bump: ace-cli >= 4.1.2, @ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2. v7.1.1: Domain-shift session-pinning + strip/gate hardening. Floor bump: ace-cli >= 4.1.2, Claude Code >= 2.1.163, @ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2. v7.1.0: Per-agent ACE attribution. v7.0.0: ACE 1.5 / ace-cli 4.0.1 compatibility milestone. Requires: Claude Code >= 2.1.163, ace-cli >= 4.1.2 (@ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2).
